items.title: Israeli Digital Humanities Index Schema
items.text:
A LinkML schema for an index of Digital Humanities (DH) research in Israel. Entities and properties reuse established vocabularies (FOAF, schema.org, Dublin Core Terms, BIBO, DCAT, EDM, SKOS, CERIF); DH projects are classified with TaDiRAH 2.0 research-activity concepts (dynamic enum over the full taxonomy). Free text supports English, Hebrew and Arabic. All entities are identified by IDHI URNs (idhi::); external PIDs are supplementary.

URI: https://idhi.co.il/linkml/idhi

Name: idhi

Publication An academic publication (BIBO document): journal article, book, chapter, conf... Service A reusable, human- or organization-mediated service offered by a facility or ... items.title: Source files
items.text:
The schema and its generated outputs are versioned in this repository. Each page renders the exact file contents included in this documentation build.

File Format Purpose IDHI LinkML schema YAML The source of truth LinkML manifest. JSON Schema JSON Generated JSON schema for the manifest. TypeScript definitions TypeScript Typescript types generated from the materialized schema. OWL/RDF ontology Turtle Linked-data ontology generated from the materialized schema.

The generated files are rebuilt from the materialized schema during the project pipeline and committed to Git. They are shown here for inspection; edit idhi.linkml.yaml, not a generated file.

items.title: Class: AcademicInstitution
items.text: A university or college.

items.title: Induced
items.text:
name: AcademicInstitution
description: A university or college.
from_schema: https://idhi.co.il/linkml/idhi
is_a: Organization
attributes:
  ror:
    name: ror
    description: The organization's ROR ID, as CURIE (ROR:04aj4c181) or full URL.
      A supplementary external identifier — the record's primary id is always the
      IDHI URN. Record it whenever the organization is registered in ROR — most universities
      and research institutes are.
    from_schema: https://idhi.co.il/linkml/idhi
    rank: 1000
    slot_uri: schema:identifier
    owner: AcademicInstitution
    domain_of:
    - Organization
    range: uriorcurie
  organization_type:
    name: organization_type
    description: The kind of organization. This enum value — not the optional subclasses
      — is the canonical discriminator; always set it.
    from_schema: https://idhi.co.il/linkml/idhi
    rank: 1000
    slot_uri: dcterms:type
    owner: AcademicInstitution
    domain_of:
    - Organization
    range: OrganizationTypeEnum
  parent_organization:
    name: parent_organization
    description: The larger organization this one is part of (e.g. a department's
      university). Use for formal containment only; looser partnerships belong in
      relationship classes.
    from_schema: https://idhi.co.il/linkml/idhi
    rank: 1000
    slot_uri: schema:parentOrganization
    owner: AcademicInstitution
    domain_of:
    - Organization
    range: Organization
  location:
    name: location
    description: Where the organization, facility or event is physically situated.
    from_schema: https://idhi.co.il/linkml/idhi
    rank: 1000
    slot_uri: schema:location
    owner: AcademicInstitution
    domain_of:
    - Organization
    - Facility
    - Event
    range: Location
  additional_urls:
    name: additional_urls
    description: Further relevant web pages beyond the homepage (blog, social-media
      profile, registry entry, press coverage...). For records describing the same
      entity in other systems use same_as instead.
    from_schema: https://idhi.co.il/linkml/idhi
    rank: 1000
    slot_uri: foaf:page
    owner: AcademicInstitution
    domain_of:
    - Organization
    - Facility
    - Project
    - Tool
    - Service
    - Event
    range: uri
    multivalued: true
  contact_email:
    name: contact_email
    description: A published contact address for the entity (office, team or service-desk
      mailbox). For a person's own addresses use 'emails'.
    from_schema: https://idhi.co.il/linkml/idhi
    rank: 1000
    slot_uri: schema:email
    owner: AcademicInstitution
    domain_of:
    - Organization
    - Facility
    - Project
    - Tool
    - Service
    - Event
    range: string
  id:
    name: id
    description: "The entity's primary identifier: an IDHI URN of the form\n  idhi:<class\
      \ name>:<random short alphanumeric id>\ne.g. idhi:person:x7k2m9 or idhi:project:a83bq1.\
      \ Minted by IDHI at record creation and never reused or changed. The class token\
      \ is the lowercase snake_case class name (Organization subclasses use \"organization\"\
      ); each concrete class enforces its own token via slot_usage. External identifiers\
      \ (ORCID, ROR, DOI...) are supplementary and go in their dedicated slots — never\
      \ here."
    from_schema: https://idhi.co.il/linkml/idhi
    rank: 1000
    slot_uri: dcterms:identifier
    identifier: true
    owner: AcademicInstitution
    domain_of:
    - NamedThing
    range: string
    required: true
    pattern: ^idhi:[a-z_]+:[0-9a-z]{4,12}$
    structured_pattern:
      syntax: ^idhi:organization:{shortid}$
      interpolated: true
  name:
    name: name
    description: Multilingual name/title. Provide at least one language; English,
      Hebrew and Arabic variants are each a separate LangString. Preferably a sortable
      name (e.g. "Smith, John" rather than "John Smith") for people and organizations;
      for projects, tools and services, use the name the team itself uses.
    from_schema: https://idhi.co.il/linkml/idhi
    rank: 1000
    slot_uri: skos:prefLabel
    owner: AcademicInstitution
    domain_of:
    - NamedThing
    range: LangString
    multivalued: true
    inlined: true
    inlined_as_list: true
  description:
    name: description
    description: Multilingual free-text description (a few sentences aimed at index
      visitors, not internal notes).
    from_schema: https://idhi.co.il/linkml/idhi
    rank: 1000
    slot_uri: dcterms:description
    owner: AcademicInstitution
    domain_of:
    - NamedThing
    range: LangString
    multivalued: true
    inlined: true
    inlined_as_list: true
  homepage:
    name: homepage
    description: Public landing page of the entity, if one exists.
    from_schema: https://idhi.co.il/linkml/idhi
    rank: 1000
    slot_uri: foaf:homepage
    owner: AcademicInstitution
    domain_of:
    - NamedThing
    range: uri
  identifiers:
    name: identifiers
    description: Additional EXTERNAL identifiers beyond the primary IDHI URN and the
      dedicated ORCID/ROR/DOI slots, as CURIEs/URIs (e.g. Wikidata QIDs, VIAF, ISNI).
    from_schema: https://idhi.co.il/linkml/idhi
    rank: 1000
    slot_uri: dcterms:identifier
    owner: AcademicInstitution
    domain_of:
    - NamedThing
    range: uriorcurie
    multivalued: true
  same_as:
    name: same_as
    description: URIs of records in OTHER systems describing the same real-world entity
      (Wikidata, PeriodO, GeoNames...). Use for linked-data alignment, not for the
      entity's own pages (use homepage).
    from_schema: https://idhi.co.il/linkml/idhi
    rank: 1000
    slot_uri: schema:sameAs
    owner: AcademicInstitution
    domain_of:
    - NamedThing
    range: uri
    multivalued: true
class_uri: schema:CollegeOrUniversity

items.title: Class: Affiliation
items.text: A person's employment/membership at an organization, with a position and dates (CERIF cfPerson_OrganisationUnit). Use for the person's institutional home(s), independent of any project.

items.title: Induced
items.text:

description: A person's employment/membership at an organization, with a position
  and dates (CERIF cfPerson_OrganisationUnit). Use for the person's institutional
  home(s), independent of any project.
from_schema: https://idhi.co.il/linkml/idhi
is_a: Relationship
attributes:

    name: member
    description: The person affiliated with the organization (by IDHI URN).
    from_schema: https://idhi.co.il/linkml/idhi

    required: true
  organization:
    name: organization
    description: The organization side of the relationship (by IDHI URN).
    from_schema: https://idhi.co.il/linkml/idhi

    domain_of:
    - Affiliation
    - OrganizationProjectRole
    - FacilityAffiliation

    required: true
  affiliation_role:

    slot_uri: schema:startDate
    owner: Affiliation
    domain_of:
    - Event
    - Relationship
    range: date
  end_date:
    name: end_date
    description: End of the event, relationship or time period. Omit for ongoing relationships
      and open-ended periods.
    from_schema: https://idhi.co.il/linkml/idhi
    rank: 1000
    slot_uri: schema:endDate
    owner: Affiliation
    domain_of:
    - Event
    - TimePeriod
    - Relationship
    range: date

items.text: The kind of contribution to a publication.

items.title: Enum: DigitalHumanitiesActivityEnum
items.text: Digital-humanities research activities, as any TaDiRAH 2.0 research-activity concept: the 7 top concepts (Analyzing, Capturing, Creating, Disseminating, Enriching, Interpreting, Storing) or any narrower concept reachable beneath them via skos:narrower (e.g. tadirah:topicModeling).

items.title: Enum: EventTypeEnum
items.text: Kinds of scholarly events.

items.title: Enum: LanguageEnum
items.text: Languages supported for free-text fields (BCP-47 tags).

items.title: Enum: LicenseEnum
items.text: Common licenses for tools and datasets. meaning: records the canonical URI (SPDX for software licenses, creativecommons.org for CC). Extend as needed; keep meanings canonical.

items.title: Enum: OrgProjectRoleEnum
items.text: An organization's role in a project (one instance per role).

items.title: Enum: OrganizationTypeEnum
items.text: Kinds of organization. Canonical discriminator for Organization; pick the value matching the organization's PRIMARY nature.

items.title: Enum: PersonOrgRoleEnum
items.text: A person's position within an organization (job/status).

items.title: Enum: ProjectRoleEnum
items.text: A person's role in a project. Where a CRediT (Contributor Roles Taxonomy) concept approximates the role, meaning: records it.

items.title: Enum: PublicationTypeEnum
items.text: The kind of publication, as any concept from the COAR Resource Types vocabulary (the de-facto repository standard, required by OpenAIRE) — e.g. coar:c_6501 (journal article), coar:c_3248 (book part), coar:c_5794 (conference paper), coar:c_46ec (thesis).

items.title: Enum: ToolServiceTypeEnum
items.text: Delivery forms for tools and kinds of services. Tool records use the software values; Service records use the service values.

items.title: idhi
items.text:
A LinkML schema for an index of Digital Humanities (DH) research in Israel. Entities and properties reuse established vocabularies (FOAF, schema.org, Dublin Core Terms, BIBO, DCAT, EDM, SKOS, CERIF); DH projects are classified with TaDiRAH 2.0 research-activity concepts (dynamic enum over the full taxonomy). Free text supports English, Hebrew and Arabic. All entities are identified by IDHI URNs (idhi::); external PIDs are supplementary.

URI: https://idhi.co.il/linkml/idhi

items.title: Slot: additional_urls
items.text: Further relevant web pages beyond the homepage (blog, social-media profile, registry entry, press coverage...). For records describing the same entity in other systems use same_as instead.

items.title: Slot: address
items.text: Postal address, multilingual.

items.title: Slot: affiliation_role
items.text: The person's position at the organization (their job/status, not their project role). Use EMPLOYEE when no finer value fits; AFFILIATE is for formal association without employment.

items.title: Slot: affiliations
items.text: The person's institutional affiliations, as reified Affiliation objects (organization + position + dates). Use for employment or formal membership, NOT for project involvement — that goes in project_participations.

items.title: Slot: author
items.text: The contributing person (by IDHI URN).

items.title: Slot: author_order
items.text: Position in the byline; 1 = first author.

items.title: Slot: authorship_role
items.text: The kind of contribution. AUTHOR is the default for byline authors; use EDITOR/TRANSLATOR for edited volumes and translations; CONTRIBUTOR for named non-byline contributions.

items.title: Slot: authorships
items.text: The person's publication contributions, as reified Authorship objects carrying byline order and role.

items.title: Slot: begin_date
items.text: Start of the time span. A string (not date) on purpose: historical periods need values like "-0100" or "circa 1500". Prefer ISO 8601 / EDTF where possible.

items.title: Slot: catalogs
items.text: All Catalog records in the index.

items.title: Slot: code_repository
items.text: Source-code repository URL (GitHub, GitLab...), if open.

items.title: Slot: contact_email
items.text: A published contact address for the entity (office, team or service-desk mailbox). For a person's own addresses use 'emails'.

items.title: Slot: datasets
items.text: The datasets this catalog aggregates (by id).

items.title: Slot: date_issued
items.text: Formal publication date (or year-01-01 if only the year is known).

items.title: Slot: description
items.text: Multilingual free-text description (a few sentences aimed at index visitors, not internal notes).

items.title: Slot: digital_humanities_activities
items.text: Digital-humanities research activities practiced in this project, tool or service, as TaDiRAH 2.0 concepts. Prefer the most specific applicable concept (e.g. tadirah:topicModeling rather than tadirah:analyzing); multiple values are expected. This is the primary DH-facet for discovery.

items.title: Slot: distribution_url
items.text: Direct download or access URL for the dataset.

items.title: Slot: documentation_url
items.text: User or developer documentation for the tool or service (manual, wiki, API reference).

items.title: Slot: doi
items.text: The publication's DOI, as CURIE (DOI:10.1234/abcd) or full URL. A supplementary external identifier — the record's primary id is always the IDHI URN. Record whenever one exists; it is the preferred dedup key.

items.title: Slot: emails
items.text: Contact email addresses (zero or more). Only record addresses the person has agreed to publish in the index.

items.title: Slot: end_date
items.text: End of the event, relationship or time period. Omit for ongoing relationships and open-ended periods.

items.title: Slot: event_type
items.text: The kind of scholarly event.

items.title: Slot: events
items.text: All Event records in the index.

items.title: Slot: facilities
items.text: All Facility records in the index.

items.title: Slot: facility
items.text: The facility side of the relationship (by IDHI URN).

items.title: Slot: facility_affiliations
items.text: The organization(s) hosting or owning this facility, as reified FacilityAffiliation objects with dates.

items.title: Slot: family_name
items.text: Family (last) name, in the person's preferred romanization. Explicitly optional — the authoritative multilingual display name lives in 'name'.

items.title: Slot: funding_amount
items.text: Total awarded funding, if public, in ILS unless noted in the project description. Omit rather than guess.

items.title: Slot: given_name
items.text: Given (first) name, in the person's preferred romanization. Explicitly optional — the authoritative multilingual display name lives in 'name'.

items.title: Slot: homepage
items.text: Public landing page of the entity, if one exists.

items.title: Slot: id
items.text:
The entity's primary identifier: an IDHI URN of the form

_ idhi::_

e.g. idhi:person:x7k2m9 or idhi:project:a83bq1. Minted by IDHI at record creation and never reused or changed. The class token is the lowercase snake_case class name (Organization subclasses use "organization"); each concrete class enforces its own token via slot_usage. External identifiers (ORCID, ROR, DOI...) are supplementary and go in their dedicated slots — never here.

items.title: Slot: identifiers
items.text: Additional EXTERNAL identifiers beyond the primary IDHI URN and the dedicated ORCID/ROR/DOI slots, as CURIEs/URIs (e.g. Wikidata QIDs, VIAF, ISNI).

items.title: Slot: language
items.text: BCP-47 language tag of the value (en, he or ar).

items.title: Slot: latitude
items.text: WGS84 latitude in decimal degrees.

items.title: Slot: license
items.text: The license under which the tool or dataset is released. Required for anything advertised as reusable; omit only if genuinely unknown.

items.title: Slot: location
items.text: Where the organization, facility or event is physically situated.

items.title: Slot: locations
items.text: All Location records in the index.

items.title: Slot: longitude
items.text: WGS84 longitude in decimal degrees.

items.title: Slot: member
items.text: The person affiliated with the organization (by IDHI URN).

items.title: Slot: name
items.text: Multilingual name/title. Provide at least one language; English, Hebrew and Arabic variants are each a separate LangString. Preferably a sortable name (e.g. "Smith, John" rather than "John Smith") for people and organizations; for projects, tools and services, use the name the team itself uses.

items.title: Slot: orcid
items.text: The person's ORCID iD, as CURIE (ORCID:0000-0002-1825-0097) or full URL. A supplementary external identifier — the record's primary id is always the IDHI URN. Strongly recommended for every researcher; enables deduplication and linking to the scholarly record.

items.title: Slot: org_project_role
items.text: The organization's function in the project: COORDINATOR leads the consortium, PARTNER contributes work, FUNDER provides money, HOST provides the institutional home. Create one relationship instance per role.

items.title: Slot: organization
items.text: The organization side of the relationship (by IDHI URN).

items.title: Slot: organization_roles
items.text: Organizations engaged in the project, as reified OrganizationProjectRole objects (coordinator, partner, funder, host).

items.title: Slot: organization_type
items.text: The kind of organization. This enum value — not the optional subclasses — is the canonical discriminator; always set it.

items.title: Slot: organizations
items.text: All Organization records in the index.

items.title: Slot: outputs_datasets
items.text: Datasets produced or curated by this project (by id).

items.title: Slot: outputs_publications
items.text: Publications resulting from this project (by id).

items.title: Slot: outputs_tools
items.text: Tools produced by this project (by id).

items.title: Slot: parent_organization
items.text: The larger organization this one is part of (e.g. a department's university). Use for formal containment only; looser partnerships belong in relationship classes.

items.title: Slot: part_of
items.text: The containing work (book for a chapter, proceedings for a paper), by IDHI URN or external URI.

items.title: Slot: participant
items.text: The person taking part in the project (by IDHI URN).

items.title: Slot: participation_role
items.text: The person's function within the project team. Use PRINCIPAL_INVESTIGATOR only for the formally designated PI(s); day-to-day scholarly work is RESEARCHER, software work is DEVELOPER, enrolled students are STUDENT regardless of their task, external mentors are ADVISOR, and CONTRIBUTOR is the fallback for anything else.

items.title: Slot: persons
items.text: All Person records in the index.

items.title: Slot: presented_at
items.text: Event(s) in the index where this publication was presented (by IDHI URN), e.g. the conference where the paper was given. Distinct from published_in, the container it appeared in.

items.title: Slot: programming_language
items.text: Main implementation language(s), comma-free single value preferred.

items.title: Slot: project
items.text: The project side of the relationship (by IDHI URN).

items.title: Slot: project_participations
items.text: The person's project involvements, as reified ProjectParticipation objects carrying the role (PI, developer...) and dates.

items.title: Slot: project_period
items.text: The project's OWN runtime (when the research is/was conducted). Do not confuse with studied_periods.

items.title: Slot: projects
items.text: All Project records in the index.

items.title: Slot: provider
items.text: The organization formally responsible for delivering the service (the one you'd contact or contract with) — set this even when the service is listed under a Facility.

items.title: Slot: publication
items.text: The publication contributed to (by IDHI URN).

items.title: Slot: publication_type
items.text: The kind of publication, as a COAR resource-type concept (journal article, book part, conference paper, thesis...). Pick the most specific applicable concept.

items.title: Slot: publications
items.text: All Publication records in the index.

items.title: Slot: published_in
items.text: Name of the journal, book or proceedings the publication appeared in, as free multilingual text. If the container work has its own IDHI record or external URI, also link it via part_of.

items.title: Slot: publisher
items.text: The organization publishing the catalog, dataset or publication (by IDHI URN).

items.title: Slot: research_disciplines
items.text: Humanities discipline(s) of the project (history, linguistics, archaeology...). Free multilingual text for now; a controlled SKOS scheme is a planned upgrade.

items.title: Slot: ror
items.text: The organization's ROR ID, as CURIE (ROR:04aj4c181) or full URL. A supplementary external identifier — the record's primary id is always the IDHI URN. Record it whenever the organization is registered in ROR — most universities and research institutes are.

items.title: Slot: same_as
items.text: URIs of records in OTHER systems describing the same real-world entity (Wikidata, PeriodO, GeoNames...). Use for linked-data alignment, not for the entity's own pages (use homepage).

items.title: Slot: service_type
items.text: The kind of service offered (digitization, consulting...).

items.title: Slot: services
items.text: All Service records in the index.

items.title: Slot: services_offered
items.text: Services this facility offers to researchers. Reference Service records by id; the Service's own 'provider' may still point at the parent Organization.

items.title: Slot: start_date
items.text: Start of the event or of a relationship's validity (e.g. when a person joined a project or organization).

items.title: Slot: studied_periods
items.text: Historical period(s) the project studies (e.g. Ottoman period), as TimePeriod records — distinct from project_period.

items.title: Slot: studied_places
items.text: Geographic focus of the research (places studied), as Location records — distinct from where the project team sits.

items.title: Slot: themes
items.text: Thematic keywords for the catalog/dataset, multilingual.

items.title: Slot: time_periods
items.text: All TimePeriod records in the index.

items.title: Slot: tool_type
items.text: The delivery form of the tool (web app, library, CLI...). Pick the single value describing how users primarily consume it.

items.title: Slot: tools
items.text: All Tool records in the index.

items.title: Slot: tools_provided
items.text: Tools this facility maintains or gives access to (by id). Use for hosted instances and lab-maintained software, not for every tool staff members happen to use.

items.title: Slot: value
items.text: The text itself, in the language given by 'language'.

items.title: IDHI LinkML schema
items.text:
<pre><code># yaml-language-server: $schema=https://linkml.io/linkml-model/linkml_model/jsonschema/meta.schema.json

# =====================================================================
# Israeli Digital Humanities Index (IDHI) — LinkML schema
# Documentation (modeling guide, identifier scheme, build workflow):
# see README.md at the repository root.
# =====================================================================
id: https://idhi.co.il/linkml/idhi
name: idhi
title: Israeli Digital Humanities Index Schema
description: >-
  A LinkML schema for an index of Digital Humanities (DH) research in Israel. Entities and properties reuse established vocabularies (FOAF, schema.org, Dublin Core Terms, BIBO, DCAT, EDM, SKOS, CERIF); DH projects are classified with TaDiRAH 2.0 research-activity concepts (dynamic enum over the full taxonomy). Free text supports English, Hebrew and Arabic. All entities are identified by IDHI URNs (idhi:<class>:<shortid>); external PIDs are supplementary.
license: https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/
version: 0.1.0

# ------------------------- PREFIXES ----------------------------------
prefixes:
  idhi: https://idhi.co.il/linkml/ # this schema's own namespace
  linkml: https://w3id.org/linkml/
  xsd: http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#
  rdf: http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#
  rdfs: http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#
  dcterms: http://purl.org/dc/terms/
  foaf: http://xmlns.com/foaf/0.1/
  bibo: http://purl.org/ontology/bibo/
  schema: http://schema.org/
  skos: http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#
  dcat: http://www.w3.org/ns/dcat#
  edm: http://www.europeana.eu/schemas/edm/
  cerif: https://w3id.org/cerif/model#
  frapo: http://purl.org/cerif/frapo/
  tadirah: https://vocabs.dariah.eu/tadirah/
  coar: http://purl.org/coar/resource_type/
  spdx: https://spdx.org/licenses/
  ORCID: https://orcid.org/
  ROR: https://ror.org/
  DOI: https://doi.org/
  wgs84: http://www.w3.org/2003/01/geo/wgs84_pos#

default_prefix: idhi
default_range: string
default_curi_maps:
  - semweb_context

imports:
  - linkml:types

# ------------------------- SETTINGS ----------------------------------
# Reusable regex fragments for structured_pattern validation.
settings:
  shortid: "[0-9a-z]{4,12}"
  orcid: "\\d{4}-\\d{4}-\\d{4}-\\d{3}[0-9X]"
  ror: "0[a-hj-km-np-tv-z0-9]{6}[0-9]{2}"

# ========================= CLASSES ===================================
classes:
  # ---- Abstract superclass -----------------------------------------
  NamedThing:
    abstract: true
    description: >-
      Root class for any identifiable IDHI entity.
      Provides the IDHI URN id, multilingual name/description, homepage and alternate identifiers. Never instantiated directly; every concrete entity inherits from it and constrains the id's class token via slot_usage.
    class_uri: schema:Thing
    slots:
      - id
      - name
      - description
      - homepage
      - identifiers
      - same_as

  # ---- Multilingual text (rdf:langString convention) ---------------
  LangString:
    description: >-
      A single language-tagged text value.
      Instances are combined in a multivalued slot to give English/Hebrew/Arabic variants of one field.
      Follows the LinkML community rdf:langString convention.
      Use one LangString per language; do not repeat a language within the same field.
    class_uri: rdf:langString
    slots:
      - language
      - value

  # ---- Agents ------------------------------------------------------
  Agent:
    abstract: true
    is_a: NamedThing
    description: >-
      A person or organization (a FOAF Agent). Abstract; use Person or Organization.
    class_uri: foaf:Agent

  Person:
    is_a: Agent
    description: >-
      A human agent in the DH index: researcher, developer, librarian, student, etc.
      Create a Person record once per human being and reference it everywhere by id; do not duplicate people per project.
    class_uri: foaf:Person
    slot_usage:
      id:
        structured_pattern:
          syntax: "^idhi:person:{shortid}$"
          interpolated: true
    slots:
      - given_name
      - family_name
      - orcid
      - emails
      - affiliations # reified Person-Organization links
      - project_participations # reified Person-Project links
      - authorships # reified Person-Publication links

  Organization:
    is_a: Agent
    description: >-
      An organization of any kind.
      Its kind (academic institution, GLAM, research center, funder, company, non-profit) is given by organization_type, which is the canonical machine-readable discriminator.
      Use the subclasses below only as optional sugar when a single, unambiguous type applies.
      All organizations — including instances of the subclasses — use the idhi:organization:<shortid> URN form.
    class_uri: foaf:Organization
    slot_usage:
      id:
        structured_pattern:
          syntax: "^idhi:organization:{shortid}$"
          interpolated: true
    slots:
      - ror
      - organization_type
      - parent_organization
      - location
      - additional_urls
      - contact_email

  # Optional convenience subclasses.
  # organization_type remains the canonical machine-readable discriminator, and the id class token stays "organization" (inherited from Organization's slot_usage).
  AcademicInstitution:
    is_a: Organization
    description: A university or college.
    class_uri: schema:CollegeOrUniversity
  GLAMInstitution:
    is_a: Organization
    description: A gallery, library, archive or museum.
    class_uri: schema:Organization
  ResearchCenter:
    is_a: Organization
    description: A research center or institute.
    class_uri: schema:ResearchOrganization
  Funder:
    is_a: Organization
    description: A funding body (foundation, council, government program).
    class_uri: schema:FundingScheme
  Company:
    is_a: Organization
    description: A commercial company.
    class_uri: schema:Corporation
  NonProfit:
    is_a: Organization
    description: A non-profit / NGO.
    class_uri: schema:NGO

  Facility:
    is_a: NamedThing
    description: >-
      A physical or virtual facility such as a DH lab, digitization studio or research infrastructure, affiliated with one or more organizations (CERIF Facility).
      Use Facility when the unit offers services/tools and has its own identity distinct from its host organization; otherwise just use the Organization.
    class_uri: cerif:Facility
    slot_usage:
      id:
        structured_pattern:
          syntax: "^idhi:facility:{shortid}$"
          interpolated: true
    slots:
      - facility_affiliations # reified Facility-Organization links
      - location
      - services_offered
      - tools_provided
      - additional_urls
      - contact_email

  Project:
    is_a: NamedThing
    description: >-
      A Digital Humanities research project, classified by TaDiRAH research activities and by research discipline.
      This is the central entity of the index; people, organizations, outputs and studied periods/places all hang off it.
    class_uri: foaf:Project
    slot_usage:
      id:
        structured_pattern:
          syntax: "^idhi:project:{shortid}$"
          interpolated: true
    slots:
      - digital_humanities_activities
      - research_disciplines
      - project_period # runtime (TimePeriod)
      - studied_periods # historical period(s) studied
      - studied_places
      - project_participations
      - organization_roles # reified Organization-Project links
      - outputs_tools
      - outputs_datasets
      - outputs_publications
      - funding_amount
      - additional_urls
      - contact_email

  Tool:
    is_a: NamedThing
    description: >-
      A reusable software tool, typically produced by a project (schema:SoftwareApplication).
      Use Tool for software that others can install, run or call; for a human-mediated offering use Service instead.
    class_uri: schema:SoftwareApplication
    slot_usage:
      id:
        structured_pattern:
          syntax: "^idhi:tool:{shortid}$"
          interpolated: true
    slots:
      - tool_type
      - code_repository
      - programming_language
      - license
      - documentation_url
      - additional_urls
      - contact_email
      - digital_humanities_activities

  Service:
    is_a: NamedThing
    description: >-
      A reusable, human- or organization-mediated service offered by a facility or organization (e.g., digitization on demand, OCR consulting, data curation support).
      Use Service when the offering requires the provider to act; use Tool for self-service software.
    class_uri: schema:Service
    slot_usage:
      id:
        structured_pattern:
          syntax: "^idhi:service:{shortid}$"
          interpolated: true
    slots:
      - service_type
      - provider
      - documentation_url
      - additional_urls
      - contact_email
      - digital_humanities_activities

  Publication:
    is_a: NamedThing
    description: >-
      An academic publication (BIBO document): journal article, book, chapter, conference paper, thesis, report, etc.
      The precise kind is given by publication_type (COAR resource type).
    class_uri: bibo:Document
    slot_usage:
      id:
        structured_pattern:
          syntax: "^idhi:publication:{shortid}$"
          interpolated: true
    slots:
      - doi
      - publication_type
      - authorships
      - date_issued
      - published_in
      - publisher
      - part_of
      - presented_at

  Event:
    is_a: NamedThing
    description: >-
      A scholarly event: conference, workshop, seminar, lecture, hackathon or exhibition.
      Use Event for time-bounded gatherings; recurring series should be modeled as one Event per occurrence.
    class_uri: schema:Event
    slot_usage:
      id:
        structured_pattern:
          syntax: "^idhi:event:{shortid}$"
          interpolated: true
    slots:
      - event_type
      - start_date
      - end_date
      - location
      - additional_urls
      - contact_email

  Location:
    is_a: NamedThing
    description: >-
      A place, optionally with geographic coordinates.
      Used both for where things ARE (org/facility/event location) and for places STUDIED by a project (studied_places).
    class_uri: schema:Place
    slot_usage:
      id:
        structured_pattern:
          syntax: "^idhi:location:{shortid}$"
          interpolated: true
    slots:
      - latitude
      - longitude
      - address

  TimePeriod:
    is_a: NamedThing
    description: >-
      A time span (EDM TimeSpan).
      Deliberately reused for two purposes: a project's runtime (project_period) and historical periods studied by a project (studied_periods), e.g. "Second Temple period".
      For historical periods, prefer linking same_as to a PeriodO or Wikidata URI.
    class_uri: edm:TimeSpan
    slot_usage:
      id:
        structured_pattern:
          syntax: "^idhi:time_period:{shortid}$"
          interpolated: true
    slots:
      - begin_date
      - end_date

  Catalog:
    is_a: NamedThing
    description: >-
      A digital archive / catalog of resources (DCAT Catalog), i.e. a curated collection of datasets and records with its own identity, such as a digital archive portal.
    class_uri: dcat:Catalog
    slot_usage:
      id:
        structured_pattern:
          syntax: "^idhi:catalog:{shortid}$"
          interpolated: true
    slots:
      - datasets
      - publisher
      - themes

  Dataset:
    is_a: NamedThing
    description: >-
      A dataset produced or curated by a project (DCAT Dataset): corpora, databases, image collections, annotation sets, etc.
    class_uri: dcat:Dataset
    slot_usage:
      id:
        structured_pattern:
          syntax: "^idhi:dataset:{shortid}$"
          interpolated: true
    slots:
      - publisher
      - license
      - date_issued
      - distribution_url
      - themes

  # ---- Reified relationship (role) classes -------------------------
  # Relationship objects are inlined and carry no IDHI URN of their own.
  Relationship:
    abstract: true
    description: >-
      Abstract base for reified, role-bearing relationships, following the CERIF link-entity and schema.org Role patterns.
      A Relationship is used instead of a direct edge whenever the connection between two entities needs its own metadata: a role and/or a validity interval.
      Never instantiated directly.
    class_uri: schema:Role
    slots:
      - start_date
      - end_date

  ProjectParticipation:
    is_a: Relationship
    description: >-
      A person's participation in a project. Create one instance per (person, project, role) combination; if a person changed roles over time, create one instance per role with start/end dates.
    class_uri: cerif:Project_Person
    slots:
      - participant # -> Person
      - project # -> Project
      - participation_role

  Affiliation:
    is_a: Relationship
    description: >-
      A person's employment/membership at an organization, with a position and dates (CERIF cfPerson_OrganisationUnit).
      Use for the person's institutional home(s), independent of any project.
    class_uri: cerif:Person_OrganisationUnit
    slots:
      - member # -> Person
      - organization # -> Organization
      - affiliation_role

  OrganizationProjectRole:
    is_a: Relationship
    description: >-
      An organization's engagement in a project (CERIF cfProject_OrganisationUnit).
      Use one instance per role: an organization that both hosts and funds a project gets two instances.
    class_uri: cerif:Project_OrganisationUnit
    slots:
      - organization # -> Organization
      - project # -> Project
      - org_project_role

  Authorship:
    is_a: Relationship
    description: >-
      A person's contribution to a publication, with author order and role.
      Create one instance per (person, publication); author_order preserves the byline sequence (1 = first author).
    class_uri: schema:Role
    slots:
      - author # -> Person
      - publication # -> Publication
      - author_order
      - authorship_role

  FacilityAffiliation:
    is_a: Relationship
    description: >-
      A facility's affiliation with an organization.
      Use one instance per hosting/owning organization; joint labs get several.
    class_uri: cerif:Facility_OrganisationUnit
    slots:
      - facility # -> Facility
      - organization # -> Organization

  # ---- Container / tree root ---------------------------------------
  IndexContainer:
    tree_root: true
    description: >-
      Top-level holder for all IDHI records.
      Big entities live exactly once in these lists; everything else references them by their IDHI URN.
    attributes:
      persons:
        description: All Person records in the index.
        multivalued: true
        inlined_as_list: true
        range: Person
      organizations:
        description: All Organization records in the index.
        multivalued: true
        inlined_as_list: true
        range: Organization
      projects:
        description: All Project records in the index.
        multivalued: true
        inlined_as_list: true
        range: Project
      facilities:
        description: All Facility records in the index.
        multivalued: true
        inlined_as_list: true
        range: Facility
      tools:
        description: All Tool records in the index.
        multivalued: true
        inlined_as_list: true
        range: Tool
      services:
        description: All Service records in the index.
        multivalued: true
        inlined_as_list: true
        range: Service
      publications:
        description: All Publication records in the index.
        multivalued: true
        inlined_as_list: true
        range: Publication
      events:
        description: All Event records in the index.
        multivalued: true
        inlined_as_list: true
        range: Event
      locations:
        description: All Location records in the index.
        multivalued: true
        inlined_as_list: true
        range: Location
      time_periods:
        description: All TimePeriod records in the index.
        multivalued: true
        inlined_as_list: true
        range: TimePeriod
      catalogs:
        description: All Catalog records in the index.
        multivalued: true
        inlined_as_list: true
        range: Catalog
      datasets:
        description: All Dataset records in the index.
        multivalued: true
        inlined_as_list: true
        range: Dataset

# ========================= SLOTS =====================================
slots:
  # --- identity / shared ---
  id:
    identifier: true
    range: string
    description: >-
      The entity's primary identifier: an IDHI URN of the form
        idhi:<class name>:<random short alphanumeric id>
      e.g. idhi:person:x7k2m9 or idhi:project:a83bq1.
      Minted by IDHI at record creation and never reused or changed.
      The class token is the lowercase snake_case class name (Organization subclasses use "organization"); each concrete class enforces its own token via slot_usage.
      External identifiers (ORCID, ROR, DOI...) are supplementary and go in their dedicated slots — never here.
    slot_uri: dcterms:identifier
    pattern: "^idhi:[a-z_]+:[0-9a-z]{4,12}$"
  name:
    range: LangString
    multivalued: true
    inlined_as_list: true
    description: >-
      Multilingual name/title. Provide at least one language; English, Hebrew and Arabic variants are each a separate LangString.
      Preferably a sortable name (e.g. "Smith, John" rather than "John Smith") for people and organizations; for projects, tools and services, use the name the team itself uses.
    slot_uri: skos:prefLabel
  description:
    range: LangString
    multivalued: true
    inlined_as_list: true
    description: >-
      Multilingual free-text description (a few sentences aimed at index visitors, not internal notes).
    slot_uri: dcterms:description
  homepage:
    range: uri
    description: Public landing page of the entity, if one exists.
    slot_uri: foaf:homepage
  identifiers:
    range: uriorcurie
    multivalued: true
    description: >-
      Additional EXTERNAL identifiers beyond the primary IDHI URN and the dedicated ORCID/ROR/DOI slots, as CURIEs/URIs (e.g. Wikidata QIDs, VIAF, ISNI).
    slot_uri: dcterms:identifier
  same_as:
    range: uri
    multivalued: true
    description: >-
      URIs of records in OTHER systems describing the same real-world entity (Wikidata, PeriodO, GeoNames...).
      Use for linked-data alignment, not for the entity's own pages (use homepage).
    slot_uri: schema:sameAs
  additional_urls:
    range: uri
    multivalued: true
    description: >-
      Further relevant web pages beyond the homepage (blog, social-media profile, registry entry, press coverage...). For records describing the same entity in other systems use same_as instead.
    slot_uri: foaf:page
  contact_email:
    description: >-
      A published contact address for the entity (office, team or service-desk mailbox). For a person's own addresses use 'emails'.
    slot_uri: schema:email

  # --- LangString ---
  language:
    range: LanguageEnum
    required: true
    description: BCP-47 language tag of the value (en, he or ar).
    slot_uri: dcterms:language
  value:
    range: string
    required: true
    description: The text itself, in the language given by 'language'.
    slot_uri: rdf:value

  # --- Person ---
  given_name:
    required: false
    description: Given (first) name, in the person's preferred romanization. Explicitly optional — the authoritative multilingual display name lives in 'name'.
    slot_uri: foaf:givenName
  family_name:
    required: false
    description: Family (last) name, in the person's preferred romanization. Explicitly optional — the authoritative multilingual display name lives in 'name'.
    slot_uri: foaf:familyName
  orcid:
    range: uriorcurie
    slot_uri: schema:identifier
    description: >-
      The person's ORCID iD, as CURIE (ORCID:0000-0002-1825-0097) or full URL.
      A supplementary external identifier — the record's primary id is always the IDHI URN.
      Strongly recommended for every researcher; enables deduplication and linking to the scholarly record.
    structured_pattern:
      syntax: "ORCID:{orcid}"
      interpolated: true
  emails:
    multivalued: true
    description: >-
      Contact email addresses (zero or more). Only record addresses the person has agreed to publish in the index.
    slot_uri: foaf:mbox
  affiliations:
    range: Affiliation
    multivalued: true
    inlined_as_list: true
    description: >-
      The person's institutional affiliations, as reified Affiliation objects (organization + position + dates).
      Use for employment or formal membership, NOT for project involvement — that goes in project_participations.
  project_participations:
    range: ProjectParticipation
    multivalued: true
    inlined_as_list: true
    description: >-
      The person's project involvements, as reified ProjectParticipation objects carrying the role (PI, developer...) and dates.
  authorships:
    range: Authorship
    multivalued: true
    inlined_as_list: true
    description: >-
      The person's publication contributions, as reified Authorship objects carrying byline order and role.

  # --- Organization ---
  ror:
    range: uriorcurie
    slot_uri: schema:identifier
    description: >-
      The organization's ROR ID, as CURIE (ROR:04aj4c181) or full URL.
      A supplementary external identifier — the record's primary id is always the IDHI URN.
      Record it whenever the organization is registered in ROR — most universities and research institutes are.
  organization_type:
    range: OrganizationTypeEnum
    description: >-
      The kind of organization. This enum value — not the optional subclasses — is the canonical discriminator; always set it.
    slot_uri: dcterms:type
  parent_organization:
    range: Organization
    description: >-
      The larger organization this one is part of (e.g. a department's university). Use for formal containment only; looser partnerships belong in relationship classes.
    slot_uri: schema:parentOrganization
  location:
    range: Location
    description: Where the organization, facility or event is physically situated.
    slot_uri: schema:location

  # --- Facility ---
  facility_affiliations:
    range: FacilityAffiliation
    multivalued: true
    inlined_as_list: true
    description: >-
      The organization(s) hosting or owning this facility, as reified FacilityAffiliation objects with dates.
  services_offered:
    range: Service
    multivalued: true
    description: >-
      Services this facility offers to researchers.
      Reference Service records by id; the Service's own 'provider' may still point at the parent Organization.
  tools_provided:
    range: Tool
    multivalued: true
    description: >-
      Tools this facility maintains or gives access to (by id).
      Use for hosted instances and lab-maintained software, not for every tool staff members happen to use.

  # --- Project ---
  digital_humanities_activities:
    range: DigitalHumanitiesActivityEnum
    multivalued: true
    description: >-
      Digital-humanities research activities practiced in this project, tool or service, as TaDiRAH 2.0 concepts.
      Prefer the most specific applicable concept (e.g. tadirah:topicModeling rather than tadirah:analyzing); multiple values are expected.
      This is the primary DH-facet for discovery.
    slot_uri: dcterms:subject
  research_disciplines:
    range: LangString
    multivalued: true
    inlined_as_list: true
    description: >-
      Humanities discipline(s) of the project (history, linguistics, archaeology...).
      Free multilingual text for now; a controlled SKOS scheme is a planned upgrade.
    slot_uri: dcterms:subject
  project_period:
    range: TimePeriod
    description: >-
      The project's OWN runtime (when the research is/was conducted). Do not confuse with studied_periods.
    slot_uri: dcterms:temporal
  studied_periods:
    range: TimePeriod
    multivalued: true
    description: >-
      Historical period(s) the project studies (e.g. Ottoman period), as TimePeriod records — distinct from project_period.
    slot_uri: dcterms:temporal
  studied_places:
    range: Location
    multivalued: true
    description: >-
      Geographic focus of the research (places studied), as Location records — distinct from where the project team sits.
    slot_uri: dcterms:spatial
  organization_roles:
    range: OrganizationProjectRole
    multivalued: true
    inlined_as_list: true
    description: >-
      Organizations engaged in the project, as reified OrganizationProjectRole objects (coordinator, partner, funder, host).
  outputs_tools:
    range: Tool
    multivalued: true
    description: Tools produced by this project (by id).
    slot_uri: schema:producer
  outputs_datasets:
    range: Dataset
    multivalued: true
    description: Datasets produced or curated by this project (by id).
  outputs_publications:
    range: Publication
    multivalued: true
    description: Publications resulting from this project (by id).
  funding_amount:
    range: float
    description: >-
      Total awarded funding, if public, in ILS unless noted in the project description. Omit rather than guess.
    slot_uri: frapo:hasMonetaryValue

  # --- Tool ---
  tool_type:
    range: ToolServiceTypeEnum
    description: >-
      The delivery form of the tool (web app, library, CLI...). Pick the single value describing how users primarily consume it.
    slot_uri: schema:applicationCategory
  code_repository:
    range: uri
    description: Source-code repository URL (GitHub, GitLab...), if open.
    slot_uri: schema:codeRepository
  programming_language:
    description: Main implementation language(s), comma-free single value preferred.
    slot_uri: schema:programmingLanguage
  license:
    range: LicenseEnum
    description: >-
      The license under which the tool or dataset is released. Required for anything advertised as reusable; omit only if genuinely unknown.
    slot_uri: dcterms:license
  documentation_url:
    range: uri
    description: >-
      User or developer documentation for the tool or service (manual, wiki, API reference).
    slot_uri: schema:softwareHelp

  # --- Service ---
  service_type:
    range: ToolServiceTypeEnum
    description: The kind of service offered (digitization, consulting...).
    slot_uri: schema:serviceType
  provider:
    range: Organization
    description: >-
      The organization formally responsible for delivering the service (the one you'd contact or contract with) — set this even when the service is listed under a Facility.
    slot_uri: schema:provider

  # --- Publication ---
  doi:
    range: uriorcurie
    slot_uri: bibo:doi
    description: >-
      The publication's DOI, as CURIE (DOI:10.1234/abcd) or full URL.
      A supplementary external identifier — the record's primary id is always the IDHI URN. Record whenever one exists; it is the preferred dedup key.
  publication_type:
    range: PublicationTypeEnum
    description: >-
      The kind of publication, as a COAR resource-type concept (journal article, book part, conference paper, thesis...). Pick the most specific applicable concept.
    slot_uri: dcterms:type
  date_issued:
    range: date
    description: Formal publication date (or year-01-01 if only the year is known).
    slot_uri: dcterms:issued
  published_in:
    range: LangString
    multivalued: true
    inlined_as_list: true
    description: >-
      Name of the journal, book or proceedings the publication appeared in, as free multilingual text. If the container work has its own IDHI record or external URI, also link it via part_of.
    slot_uri: schema:isPartOf
  presented_at:
    range: Event
    multivalued: true
    description: >-
      Event(s) in the index where this publication was presented (by IDHI URN), e.g. the conference where the paper was given. Distinct from published_in, the container it appeared in.
    slot_uri: bibo:presentedAt
  part_of:
    range: uriorcurie
    description: >-
      The containing work (book for a chapter, proceedings for a paper), by IDHI URN or external URI.
    slot_uri: dcterms:isPartOf

  # --- Event ---
  event_type:
    range: EventTypeEnum
    description: The kind of scholarly event.
    slot_uri: dcterms:type
  start_date:
    range: date
    description: >-
      Start of the event or of a relationship's validity (e.g. when a person joined a project or organization).
    slot_uri: schema:startDate
  end_date:
    range: date
    description: >-
      End of the event, relationship or time period. Omit for ongoing relationships and open-ended periods.
    slot_uri: schema:endDate

  # --- Location ---
  latitude:
    range: float
    description: WGS84 latitude in decimal degrees.
    slot_uri: wgs84:lat
  longitude:
    range: float
    description: WGS84 longitude in decimal degrees.
    slot_uri: wgs84:long
  address:
    range: LangString
    multivalued: true
    inlined_as_list: true
    description: Postal address, multilingual.
    slot_uri: schema:address

  # --- TimePeriod ---
  begin_date:
    range: string
    description: >-
      Start of the time span. A string (not date) on purpose: historical periods need values like "-0100" or "circa 1500". Prefer ISO 8601 / EDTF where possible.
    slot_uri: edm:begin
  # end_date is reused from the Event group above

  # --- Catalog / Dataset ---
  datasets:
    range: Dataset
    multivalued: true
    description: The datasets this catalog aggregates (by id).
    slot_uri: dcat:dataset
  publisher:
    range: Organization
    description: The organization publishing the catalog, dataset or publication (by IDHI URN).
    slot_uri: dcterms:publisher
  themes:
    range: LangString
    multivalued: true
    inlined_as_list: true
    description: Thematic keywords for the catalog/dataset, multilingual.
    slot_uri: dcat:theme
  distribution_url:
    range: uri
    description: Direct download or access URL for the dataset.
    slot_uri: dcat:downloadURL

  # --- Relationship endpoints & roles --------------------------------
  participant:
    range: Person
    required: true
    description: The person taking part in the project (by IDHI URN).
  project:
    range: Project
    required: true
    description: The project side of the relationship (by IDHI URN).
  participation_role:
    range: ProjectRoleEnum
    description: >-
      The person's function within the project team.
      Use PRINCIPAL_INVESTIGATOR only for the formally designated PI(s); day-to-day scholarly work is RESEARCHER, software work is DEVELOPER, enrolled students are STUDENT regardless of their task, external mentors are ADVISOR, and CONTRIBUTOR is the fallback for anything else.
    slot_uri: schema:roleName
  member:
    range: Person
    required: true
    description: The person affiliated with the organization (by IDHI URN).
  organization:
    range: Organization
    required: true
    description: The organization side of the relationship (by IDHI URN).
  affiliation_role:
    range: PersonOrgRoleEnum
    description: >-
      The person's position at the organization (their job/status, not their project role).
      Use EMPLOYEE when no finer value fits; AFFILIATE is for formal association without employment.
    slot_uri: schema:roleName
  org_project_role:
    range: OrgProjectRoleEnum
    description: >-
      The organization's function in the project: COORDINATOR leads the consortium, PARTNER contributes work, FUNDER provides money, HOST provides the institutional home.
      Create one relationship instance per role.
    slot_uri: schema:roleName
  author:
    range: Person
    required: true
    description: The contributing person (by IDHI URN).
  publication:
    range: Publication
    required: true
    description: The publication contributed to (by IDHI URN).
  author_order:
    range: integer
    description: Position in the byline; 1 = first author.
    slot_uri: schema:position
  authorship_role:
    range: AuthorshipRoleEnum
    description: >-
      The kind of contribution.
      AUTHOR is the default for byline authors; use EDITOR/TRANSLATOR for edited volumes and translations; CONTRIBUTOR for named non-byline contributions.
    slot_uri: schema:roleName
  facility:
    range: Facility
    required: true
    description: The facility side of the relationship (by IDHI URN).

# ========================= ENUMS =====================================
enums:
  LanguageEnum:
    description: Languages supported for free-text fields (BCP-47 tags).
    permissible_values:
      en:
        description: English
      he:
        description: Hebrew
      ar:
        description: Arabic

  # ------------------------ DYNAMIC ENUMS ---------------------------
  DigitalHumanitiesActivityEnum:
    description: >-
      Digital-humanities research activities, as any TaDiRAH 2.0 research-activity concept: the 7 top concepts (Analyzing, Capturing, Creating, Disseminating, Enriching, Interpreting, Storing) or any narrower concept reachable beneath them via skos:narrower (e.g. tadirah:topicModeling).
    annotations:
      source_url: https://vocabs.dariah.eu/rest/v1/tadirah/data?format=text/turtle
      source_format: turtle
    reachable_from:
      source_ontology: https://vocabs.dariah.eu/tadirah/
      source_nodes:
        - tadirah:analyzing
        - tadirah:capturing
        - tadirah:creating
        - tadirah:disseminating
        - tadirah:enriching
        - tadirah:interpreting
        - tadirah:storing
      include_self: true
      relationship_types:
        - skos:narrower

  PublicationTypeEnum:
    description: >-
      The kind of publication, as any concept from the COAR Resource Types vocabulary (the de-facto repository standard, required by OpenAIRE) — e.g. coar:c_6501 (journal article), coar:c_3248 (book part), coar:c_5794 (conference paper), coar:c_46ec (thesis).
    annotations:
      source_url: https://vocabularies.coar-repositories.org/resource_types/resource_types.nt
      source_format: n-triples
    matches:
      source_ontology: http://purl.org/coar/resource_type/
      identifier_pattern: "^http://purl\\.org/coar/resource_type/.+$"

  # ------------------------ STATIC ENUMS ----------------------------
  # Small, IDHI-governed vocabularies are kept static on purpose:
  # dynamic enums pay off for large external taxonomies, not for a
  # handful of locally-controlled values. Where an external concept
  # exists (schema.org, CRediT, SPDX), `meaning:` records it.

  OrganizationTypeEnum:
    description: >-
      Kinds of organization. Canonical discriminator for Organization; pick the value matching the organization's PRIMARY nature.
    permissible_values:
      ACADEMIC_INSTITUTION:
        description: A degree-granting university or college.
        meaning: schema:CollegeOrUniversity
      GLAM_INSTITUTION:
        description: A gallery, library, archive or museum.
      RESEARCH_CENTER:
        description: >-
          A research center or institute, whether independent or within a university (if within one, also set parent_organization).
        meaning: schema:ResearchOrganization
      FUNDER:
        description: A body whose primary role is funding research.
        meaning: schema:FundingScheme
      COMPANY:
        description: A commercial company.
        meaning: schema:Corporation
      NON_PROFIT:
        description: A non-profit organization / NGO.
        meaning: schema:NGO

  ProjectRoleEnum:
    description: >-
      A person's role in a project. Where a CRediT (Contributor Roles Taxonomy) concept approximates the role, `meaning:` records it.
    permissible_values:
      PRINCIPAL_INVESTIGATOR:
        description: The formally designated lead researcher (PI).
      CO_PI:
        description: A formally designated co-principal investigator.
      RESEARCHER:
        description: A team member conducting the scholarly research.
        meaning: https://credit.niso.org/contributor-roles/investigation/
      DEVELOPER:
        description: A team member building the project's software.
        meaning: https://credit.niso.org/contributor-roles/software/
      STUDENT:
        description: >-
          An enrolled student (BA/MA/PhD) working on the project in any capacity — student status takes precedence over task.
      ADVISOR:
        description: An external mentor or advisory-board member.
        meaning: https://credit.niso.org/contributor-roles/supervision/
      CONTRIBUTOR:
        description: Fallback for any other named involvement.

  PersonOrgRoleEnum:
    description: A person's position within an organization (job/status).
    permissible_values:
      PROFESSOR:
        description: Faculty member of any professorial rank.
      ASSOCIATE:
        description: Research associate / postdoc.
      MEMBER:
        description: Formal member of a center, lab or society.
      MANAGER:
        description: Administrative or lab manager.
      AFFILIATE:
        description: Formal association without employment.
      EMPLOYEE:
        description: Staff fallback when no finer value fits.

  OrgProjectRoleEnum:
    description: An organization's role in a project (one instance per role).
    permissible_values:
      COORDINATOR:
        description: Leads/coordinates the project or consortium.
      PARTNER:
        description: Contributes work as a consortium member.
      FUNDER:
        description: Provides funding for the project.
      HOST:
        description: Provides the institutional/administrative home.

  AuthorshipRoleEnum:
    description: The kind of contribution to a publication.
    permissible_values:
      AUTHOR:
        description: Byline author (the default).
      EDITOR:
        description: Editor of a volume or collection.
      TRANSLATOR:
        description: Translator of the work.
      CONTRIBUTOR:
        description: Named non-byline contribution.

  EventTypeEnum:
    description: Kinds of scholarly events.
    permissible_values:
      CONFERENCE:
        description: A multi-session academic conference.
        meaning: bibo:Conference
      WORKSHOP:
        description: A hands-on or small-group working meeting.
      SEMINAR:
        description: A recurring or one-off academic seminar session.
      LECTURE:
        description: A single public or academic talk.
      HACKATHON:
        description: A time-boxed collaborative building event.
      EXHIBITION:
        description: A curated public display (physical or digital).

  ToolServiceTypeEnum:
    description: >-
      Delivery forms for tools and kinds of services. Tool records use the software values; Service records use the service values.
    permissible_values:
      WEB_APPLICATION:
        description: Software used through a browser.
        meaning: schema:WebApplication
      DESKTOP_APPLICATION:
        description: Software installed on a user's machine.
      LIBRARY:
        description: A code library/package imported by other software.
      COMMAND_LINE_TOOL:
        description: Software operated from a terminal.
      DATABASE:
        description: A queryable data system offered as a tool.
      API_SERVICE:
        description: A programmatic service accessed over the network.
      DIGITIZATION_SERVICE:
        description: Human-mediated digitization (scanning, imaging, OCR).
      CONSULTING_SERVICE:
        description: Human-mediated expertise (methods, data, tech advice).

  LicenseEnum:
    description: >-
      Common licenses for tools and datasets. `meaning:` records the canonical URI (SPDX for software licenses, creativecommons.org for CC).
      Extend as needed; keep meanings canonical.
    permissible_values:
      CC_BY_4_0:
        description: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0.
        meaning: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/
      CC_BY_SA_4_0:
        description: Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 4.0.
        meaning: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/
      CC0_1_0:
        description: Creative Commons Zero (public domain dedication).
        meaning: https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/
      MIT:
        description: MIT License.
        meaning: spdx:MIT
      APACHE_2_0:
        description: Apache License 2.0.
        meaning: spdx:Apache-2.0
      GPL_3_0:
        description: GNU GPL v3.0 (or later).
        meaning: spdx:GPL-3.0-or-later
</code></pre>

<pre><code>{
    "$defs": {
        "AcademicInstitution": {
            "additionalProperties": false,
            "description": "A university or college.",
            "properties": {
                "additional_urls": {
                    "description": "Further relevant web pages beyond the homepage (blog, social-media profile, registry entry, press coverage...). For records describing the same entity in other systems use same_as instead.",
                    "items": {
                        "format": "uri",
                        "type": "string"
                    },
                    "type": [
                        "array",
                        "null"
                    ]
                },
                "contact_email": {
                    "description": "A published contact address for the entity (office, team or service-desk mailbox). For a person's own addresses use 'emails'.",
                    "type": [
                        "string",
                        "null"
                    ]
                },
                "description": {
                    "description": "Multilingual free-text description (a few sentences aimed at index visitors, not internal notes).",
                    "items": {
                        "$ref": "#/$defs/LangString"
                    },
                    "type": [
                        "array",
                        "null"
                    ]
                },
                "homepage": {
                    "description": "Public landing page of the entity, if one exists.",
                    "format": "uri",
                    "type": [
                        "string",
                        "null"
                    ]
                },
                "id": {
                    "description": "The entity's primary identifier: an IDHI URN of the form\n  idhi:<class name>:<random short alphanumeric id>\ne.g. idhi:person:x7k2m9 or idhi:project:a83bq1. Minted by IDHI at record creation and never reused or changed. The class token is the lowercase snake_case class name (Organization subclasses use \"organization\"); each concrete class enforces its own token via slot_usage. External identifiers (ORCID, ROR, DOI...) are supplementary and go in their dedicated slots \u2014 never here.",
                    "pattern": "^idhi:organization:[0-9a-z]{4,12}$",
                    "type": "string"
                },
                "identifiers": {
                    "description": "Additional EXTERNAL identifiers beyond the primary IDHI URN and the dedicated ORCID/ROR/DOI slots, as CURIEs/URIs (e.g. Wikidata QIDs, VIAF, ISNI).",
                    "items": {
                        "type": "string"
                    },
                    "type": [
                        "array",
                        "null"
                    ]
                },
                "location": {
                    "description": "Where the organization, facility or event is physically situated.",
                    "type": [
                        "string",
                        "null"
                    ]
                },
                "name": {
                    "description": "Multilingual name/title. Provide at least one language; English, Hebrew and Arabic variants are each a separate LangString. Preferably a sortable name (e.g. \"Smith, John\" rather than \"John Smith\") for people and organizations; for projects, tools and services, use the name the team itself uses.",
                    "items": {
                        "$ref": "#/$defs/LangString"
                    },
                    "type": [
                        "array",
                        "null"
                    ]
                },
                "organization_type": {
                    "$ref": "#/$defs/OrganizationTypeEnum",
                    "description": "The kind of organization. This enum value \u2014 not the optional subclasses \u2014 is the canonical discriminator; always set it."
                },
                "parent_organization": {
                    "description": "The larger organization this one is part of (e.g. a department's university). Use for formal containment only; looser partnerships belong in relationship classes.",
                    "type": [
                        "string",
                        "null"
                    ]
                },
                "ror": {
                    "description": "The organization's ROR ID, as CURIE (ROR:04aj4c181) or full URL. A supplementary external identifier \u2014 the record's primary id is always the IDHI URN. Record it whenever the organization is registered in ROR \u2014 most universities and research institutes are.",
                    "type": [
                        "string",
                        "null"
                    ]
                },
                "same_as": {
                    "description": "URIs of records in OTHER systems describing the same real-world entity (Wikidata, PeriodO, GeoNames...). Use for linked-data alignment, not for the entity's own pages (use homepage).",
                    "items": {
                        "format": "uri",
                        "type": "string"
                    },
                    "type": [
                        "array",
                        "null"
                    ]
                }
            },
            "required": [
                "id"
            ],
            "title": "AcademicInstitution",
            "type": "object"
        },
        "Affiliation": {
            "additionalProperties": false,
            "description": "A person's employment/membership at an organization, with a position and dates (CERIF cfPerson_OrganisationUnit). Use for the person's institutional home(s), independent of any project.",
            "properties": {
                "affiliation_role": {
                    "$ref": "#/$defs/PersonOrgRoleEnum",
                    "description": "The person's position at the organization (their job/status, not their project role). Use EMPLOYEE when no finer value fits; AFFILIATE is for formal association without employment."
                },
                "end_date": {
                    "description": "End of the event, relationship or time period. Omit for ongoing relationships and open-ended periods.",
                    "format": "date",
                    "type": [
                        "string",
                        "null"
                    ]
                },
                "member": {
                    "description": "The person affiliated with the organization (by IDHI URN).",
                    "type": "string"
                },
                "organization": {
                    "description": "The organization side of the relationship (by IDHI URN).",
                    "type": "string"
                },
                "start_date": {
                    "description": "Start of the event or of a relationship's validity (e.g. when a person joined a project or organization).",
                    "format": "date",
                    "type": [
                        "string",
                        "null"
                    ]
                }
            },
            "required": [
                "member",
                "organization"
            ],
            "title": "Affiliation",
            "type": "object"
        },
        "Agent": {
            "additionalProperties": false,
            "description": "A person or organization (a FOAF Agent). Abstract; use Person or Organization.",
            "properties": {
                "description": {
                    "description": "Multilingual free-text description (a few sentences aimed at index visitors, not internal notes).",
                    "items": {
                        "$ref": "#/$defs/LangString"
                    },
                    "type": [
                        "array",
                        "null"
                    ]
                },
                "homepage": {
                    "description": "Public landing page of the entity, if one exists.",
                    "format": "uri",
                    "type": [
                        "string",

                    ]
                },
                "id": {
                    "description": "The entity's primary identifier: an IDHI URN of the form\n  idhi:<class name>:<random short alphanumeric id>\ne.g. idhi:person:x7k2m9 or idhi:project:a83bq1. Minted by IDHI at record creation and never reused or changed. The class token is the lowercase snake_case class name (Organization subclasses use \"organization\"); each concrete class enforces its own token via slot_usage. External identifiers (ORCID, ROR, DOI...) are supplementary and go in their dedicated slots \u2014 never here.",
                    "pattern": "^idhi:[a-z_]+:[0-9a-z]{4,12}$",
                    "type": "string"
                },
                "identifiers": {
                    "description": "Additional EXTERNAL identifiers beyond the primary IDHI URN and the dedicated ORCID/ROR/DOI slots, as CURIEs/URIs (e.g. Wikidata QIDs, VIAF, ISNI).",
                    "items": {
                        "type": "string"
                    },
                    "type": [
                        "array",
                        "null"
                    ]
                },
                "name": {
                    "description": "Multilingual name/title. Provide at least one language; English, Hebrew and Arabic variants are each a separate LangString. Preferably a sortable name (e.g. \"Smith, John\" rather than \"John Smith\") for people and organizations; for projects, tools and services, use the name the team itself uses.",
                    "items": {
                        "$ref": "#/$defs/LangString"
                    },
                    "type": [
                        "array",
                        "null"
                    ]
                },
                "same_as": {
                    "description": "URIs of records in OTHER systems describing the same real-world entity (Wikidata, PeriodO, GeoNames...). Use for linked-data alignment, not for the entity's own pages (use homepage).",
                    "items": {
                        "format": "uri",
                        "type": "string"
                    },
                    "type": [
                        "array",
                        "null"
                    ]
                }
            },
            "required": [
                "id"
            ],
            "title": "Agent",
            "type": "object"
        },
        "Authorship": {
            "additionalProperties": false,
            "description": "A person's contribution to a publication, with author order and role. Create one instance per (person, publication); author_order preserves the byline sequence (1 = first author).",
            "properties": {
                "author": {
                    "description": "The contributing person (by IDHI URN).",
                    "type": "string"
                },
                "author_order": {
                    "description": "Position in the byline; 1 = first author.",
                    "type": [
                        "integer",
                        "null"
                    ]
                },
                "authorship_role": {
                    "$ref": "#/$defs/AuthorshipRoleEnum",
                    "description": "The kind of contribution. AUTHOR is the default for byline authors; use EDITOR/TRANSLATOR for edited volumes and translations; CONTRIBUTOR for named non-byline contributions."
                },
                "end_date": {
                    "description": "End of the event, relationship or time period. Omit for ongoing relationships and open-ended periods.",
                    "format": "date",
                    "type": [
                        "string",
                        "null"
                    ]
                },
                "publication": {
                    "description": "The publication contributed to (by IDHI URN).",
                    "type": "string"
                },
                "start_date": {
                    "description": "Start of the event or of a relationship's validity (e.g. when a person joined a project or organization).",
                    "format": "date",
                    "type": [
                        "string",
                        "null"
                    ]
                }
            },
            "required": [
                "author",

<pre><code>@prefix bibo: <http://purl.org/ontology/bibo/> .

@prefix owl: <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#> .

@prefix tadirah: <https://vocabs.dariah.eu/tadirah/> .
@prefix xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#> .

idhi:AcademicInstitution a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "AcademicInstitution" ;
    rdfs:subClassOf idhi:Organization ;
    skos:definition "A university or college." ;
    skos:exactMatch schema1:CollegeOrUniversity ;
    skos:inScheme idhi:idhi .

idhi:Company a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "Company" ;
    rdfs:subClassOf idhi:Organization ;
    skos:definition "A commercial company." ;
    skos:exactMatch schema1:Corporation ;
    skos:inScheme idhi:idhi .

idhi:Funder a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "Funder" ;
    rdfs:subClassOf idhi:Organization ;
    skos:definition "A funding body (foundation, council, government program)." ;
    skos:exactMatch schema1:FundingScheme ;
    skos:inScheme idhi:idhi .

idhi:GLAMInstitution a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "GLAMInstitution" ;
    rdfs:subClassOf idhi:Organization ;
    skos:definition "A gallery, library, archive or museum." ;
    skos:exactMatch schema1:Organization ;
    skos:inScheme idhi:idhi .
